method_note: Twelve uint8 terrain-descriptor channels aggregated from 2 m work cells; upstream metadata identifies USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM tiles. Quantized descriptors are not fault labels or a fault-detection raster.
rights_note: Upstream metadata states USGS 3DEP products are available without use restrictions; the source feature file is a public sibling-repository derivative.
caveats: uncalibrated terrain descriptors, not fault detections
roads, channels, terrace risers, paleo-shorelines, landslides and mines also create steps
upstream metadata reports 10 failed tiles out of 716 and approximately 1-2 m datum offset
source is a sibling feature product; no sibling prediction raster is used
label: PUBLIC-REPOSITORY-DERIVATIVE; not organizer-provided and not an organizer score receipt
